items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
SUMMARY OF LEARNED LESSONS (all items observed in play unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire tears, which with Tech X become a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15–0.2 room-units) in the firing direction on the player's row. Rocks block the ring. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse, ~2-tile radius); bomb count decrements on placement. Q and Space do nothing — don't retry. Diagonal and single-axis moves stall against rocks whose hitbox exceeds the sprite; reposition to another lane.

HATCH/DOORWAY WARP MECHANICS (refined): requires near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1–0.2 units from the frame. Standing ON the frame blocks the warp — step off (~0.2 down), nudge to center, then hold the sustained walk; works reliably after that. Sometimes takes several attempts. If a warp fails, re-center rather than pressing harder.

TECH X (confirmed respawnable): item pedestal in the two-poop room RESPAWNS the Tech X pill between visits — re-acquired it there after previously taking it. Ring destroys poop piles in ~2 hits. Ring killed a transformed green hopper at ~0.15 units but cost a heart in the exchange — ranged tool, not a safe one. Ring did NOT open the ringed gray chest.

RINGED/LIDDED CHESTS — KEY-LOCKED (strong evidence, one negative result): firing Tech X at the torch-room ringed gray chest produced a RED crossed/padlock-like marker over it; the surrounding rock ring was NOT damaged by lasers. So the earlier 'cleared the ring rocks' belief was really the poop pile. Red-lidded brown containers in the dark room also stayed closed on contact with no key held. Working conclusion: red-lidded and rock-ringed chests need a KEY, not damage; the spike-enclosed central chest in the dark room is untouchable/dangerous. (Uncertain: whether a key genuinely exists and where.) Earlier a key-shaped pickup did NOT raise the keys counter, so don't assume shape=key.

BOMBS — FAILED STRATEGY: placing a bomb at feet then warping out still cost a heart (fuse outlasts the warp); cost 2 hearts, one killed a prior run. Do NOT bomb adjacent to self, especially at 1 heart; if bombing, place then retreat to a far corner and wait out the blast.

MAP / ROUTES:
- Tutorial: top trapezoid x~0.50 ↔ rock field; bottom trapezoid x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room; right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom trapezoid ~x0.49 ↔ tutorial; top exit ↔ TNT room; keyhole door on left wall (~0.19,0.44) with no key yet; green gem near top area; white-faced chasers and green blobs roam; upper-right cluster dangerous.
- Torch room: top alcove x~0.50 ↔ tutorial; CLEAR LEFT LANE x~0.31–0.42 runs full height (confirmed safe route up/down); center-lower rock cluster blocks direct descent; right lane x~0.63–0.66 also traversable down (watch bottom-right torch x~0.75,y~0.68); gold hatch at bottom center x~0.50, y~0.76–0.79 ↔ two-poop room (approach ~0.1 above, centered). Corner torches damage on contact; left torch x~0.26,y~0.66 and right torch are close to lanes.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1 below); poop piles regenerate on re-entry; pedestal respawns Tech X.
- TNT room (reached earlier via rock-field top exit): barrels along left wall; gray chests wedged ~y0.30 and ~y0.63; red-lidded brown barrel near the lower one.
- Beyond TNT: pink-enemy rock room (pink fat enemies, poop pile with blue flies).
- Dark chest room (right of tutorial): two red-lidded brown containers (x~0.33,y~0.30 and x~0.65,y~0.30), central red-lidded chest fully enclosed in white spikes, black blob/pit shapes around x~0.33,y~0.48 and x~0.65,y~0.48, gold/olive specks near x~0.25–0.28,y~0.36–0.49.

HAZARDS: the ROCK FIELD is a heart-drainer — a green blob with yellow halo near the top exit caused a heart loss right at the doorway, and the bottom-exit warp also cost a heart on the way back; do not camp in doorways there, and avoid the room when low. White-faced blobs are chasers; blobs transform into winged/spread and large fast green forms; spiky ring blobs can form beside the player. The green gem-like blob in the rock-field upper area coincided with a heart loss — treat as TRAP, do not approach (effect still uncertain). Dark chest room is a chaser den. Death state = empty grey heart outlines + bloodied/enlarged sprite (not yet experienced this run).

PICKUPS: hearts need overlap (+1). Coins need near-exact overlap; some gold specks never register (tolerance unresolved). Bomb pickups auto-collect on overlap. Chests gave a bomb pickup and a red heart when opened via contact earlier.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource; keys still never obtained (keys counter stayed 00). Open red-lidded/ringed chests, which now appear to require a key. Test the rock-field keyhole door only with a confirmed key.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door; whether/where keys exist; exact key mechanics for red-lidded containers (strongly suspected key-locked); the green gem's effect; the red marker's exact meaning (interpreted as locked, uncertain); whether lasers can open a chest through a rock ring (evidence: no); exact coin pickup tolerance; bomb fuse length relative to warp timing (longer than a ~0.5s warp)."}</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>
